item.tib: khro phur gnyis kyi gdangs yig 'brug mo
item.coloph: khro phur gnyis kyi gdangs yig 'brug mo ldir ba 'di/ gshen gyi drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi snyan rgyud khyad par can/ 'di la brtson pa'i gang zag rnams/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par nges/ khro phur gnyis kyi gdangs yig gong 'og spel ma 'di/ rmongs pa can gyi rig rtsal yin pas 'gal 'khrul mchis na khro phur lha la bshags/ dmar lam gang yin mjug gyer skabs mgyogs 'dar mi dgos/ bkra shis//
